issues.display_title: Issue #340: Add is_published validation to AddBookmark API (block add/remove on published folder)
issues.main_description_html:
Result - 9 June 2026

Implementation Complete - Ready for Unit Testing

Implementation

Objective

Block add and remove bookmark operations for bookmark folders where is_published = true, to preserve data integrity.

API

File: src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/AddBookmark.go

Tasks

  • Use the shared CheckFolderPublished(c *fiber.Ctx, qSid string, sid string, userId string) (FolderStatus, bool) helper in src/Utils/Functions/BookmarkFunctions/BookmarkFunctions.go.
    • Query the folder_bookmark table.
    • Return 409 Conflict if the folder is not found.
    • Return 403 Forbidden with Activity not allowed for published folder if is_published = true.
  • Call the helper in AddBookmark.go to block add/remove activity on published folders.

How to test

  1. Identify a bookmark folder where is_published = true.
  2. Call the AddBookmark API for that folder.
  3. Expected: 403 Forbidden with Activity not allowed for published folder; the bookmark is not added.

Verification

  • go build passes for the affected package.
  • The API returns a consistent 403 and message.

Testing scenarios

Preconditions

  • Valid authenticated user with bookmark-folder access.
  • One published folder (Folder A) and one unpublished folder (Folder B).
ID Scenario Expected result
TC-1 Add a bookmark to Folder A 403 Forbidden; bookmark is not added.
TC-2 Remove a bookmark from Folder A 403 Forbidden; bookmark is not removed.
TC-3 Add a bookmark to Folder B Successful normal response; bookmark is added.
TC-4 Remove a bookmark from Folder B Successful normal response; bookmark is removed.
TC-5 Use a nonexistent folder ID 409 Conflict.
TC-6 Regression check for Folder B Existing add/remove behavior remains unchanged.

Pass criteria: TC-1 and TC-2 return 403 with the exact message; TC-3 and TC-4 succeed; TC-5 returns 409; no regression is introduced.

Source: docs/brainstorm/2026-06-09-add-bookmark-validation.md

issues.main_description_html:
Result - 10 June 2026

Implementation Complete - Ready for Unit Testing

Implementation

Overview

Expand GET /check-connection so it reports core infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and internal services used by the API.

New services to monitor

  • RabbitMQ Toronto
  • Centrifugo (ENDPOINT_CENTRIFUGO)
  • SMTP (SMTP_HOST / SMTP_PORT)
  • Maps API (API_MAPS)
  • GoThru API (API_GOTHRU)

Architectural requirements

  • Reuse RabbitMQ.GetConnection() rather than opening a new TCP connection for every request.
  • Fall back to a temporary dial when the singleton connection is unavailable or closed.
  • Apply a five-second timeout to HTTP checks for Centrifugo, Maps, and GoThru.
  • Treat any HTTP status below 500 as reachable, including 401 and 403.

Endpoint

URL: GET /check-connection
Authentication: none; available to monitoring tools.

{
  "status": "ok",
  "services": {
    "database": "up",
    "redis": "up",
    "elasticsearch": "up",
    "rabbitmq": "up",
    "minio": "up",
    "rabbitmq_toronto": "up",
    "centrifugo": "up",
    "smtp": "up",
    "maps_api": "up",
    "gothru_api": "up"
  }
}
